description:
Starts a server backup (full or incremental) in the background — the panel's backup job: it waits its turn behind other backups, is logged, notifies the caller and is uploaded to the remote destinations. The answer comes at once (202) with the job's id; GET /v1/backup-jobs/:id follows it. It used to back up inside the request: hours behind the queue, while the client gave up — and nothing was uploaded.

HTTP: POST /v1/backups
Category: Backups
Required scopes: backups:write
Returns: {status, data: object {backup_id, backup_name, status, domains}, message}
Mutating: changes server state.
